arms.requirement: Model plus instruction only; no environment or retrieval pack.
Same model with a lexical public-evidence pack; no boundary tools.
Sealed scripted policy through the boundary against the frozen episode.

models.selection_rule: Current frontier chat model authorised for cleanroom; freeze id before run.
Current open-weight chat model authorised for cleanroom; freeze id before run.

grading.primary: cleanroom episode complete flag / reward from free_run metrics
grading.dual_judge_when_llm_used: Required when an LLM grades free-form answers; not used for scripted oracle.
grading.reward: 1.0 iff episode complete under the arm policy; else not 1.0

issue_rule: ISSUED only when unaided_fails, naive_retrieval_fails and oracle_passes each have non-null executed evidence for the named model and date; never invent arm outcomes.
missing_result_policy: Leave result and evidence null; keep status NOT_ISSUED; record halt.todo.
halt_conditions: Provider unavailable or identity unbound for either model slot
Sealed-set or baseline-v2 metrics hash mismatch against evidence-manifest
Attempt to mark ISSUED while any required arm result is null
Attempt to map frontier/open_weight full-boundary gate runs onto unaided or naive arms
how_to_run: Live unaided and naive arms require new free_run policies and provider capacity; do not freeze this prereg until those policies land.
